index_convention: All variable and row indices are zero-based original native indices; no SAT IDs.
appended_row_order: All positive-tip opposite-triangle units by increasing tip, then degree-lower-bound rows in the same tip order.

theorem_contracts.absence: Genuine PL3sphere; positive edge valence3; all three opposite edges ordinary valence4/5; minimum degree6. Opposite triangle absent.
theorem_contracts.degree: Every vertex link S2; positive tip incident with exactly one valence3 exceptional edge and all other edges valence4/5; minimum degree6. Tip degree at least7.

proposed_pilot.forecast_kind: Historical same-dimension scheduling prior, not a target propagation runtime guarantee.
